body: Added POST /api/v1/shankpit/ticket (IDUNA) minting short-lived HMAC-SHA256 connect tickets bound to player_id; C server (apps/server/src/main.c) now verifies them on PACKET_CONNECT before allocating a slot, fails closed if unset, and enforces one-seat-per-identity (VS2). Self-contained C HMAC-SHA256, verified against RFC 4231. emily-bot gained -bad-ticket/-no-ticket/-same-identity test modes. End-to-end testing on an isolated instance surfaced and fixed a real auth bypass: PACKET_USERCMD auto-welcomed any unrecognized sender via ensure_slot_for_sender, completely skipping ticket verification. Fixed via find_slot_by_addr (lookup-only). All 4 scenarios verified live before deploying to production. IDUNA f2a3c69/e2af228, shankpit-460 e78cc07/fa316c6.
title: S156-02: HMAC connect-ticket auth on shankpit-460 PACKET_CONNECT
